title: Existence theory for non-variational systems with free boundaries
summary: We study the existence of solutions for systems of both elliptic and parabolic partial differential equations with potentially singular right-hand sides and free boundaries, posed in general smooth domains. Our results are established within a framework of "meta-theorems." This approach hinges on specific strong properties of the operators and their solutions (in approximate smooth settings) to guarantee the existence of a limit as the approximation parameter tends to zero.
